name: masonry
title: Masonry
description: Tiles of their own heights, packed into lanes with no gaps under them.
use: A collection of things of different heights that should not be cut to one: pictures at their own ratios, notes, quotes, cards with a paragraph or none. Lanes are counted from the room, none narrower than --masonry-min. Every tile is a masonry-item. When the tiles should line up in rows, use an auto grid.

instead.when: The tiles should line up in rows, or they are of one size
A few tiles are larger than the rest on purpose

platform.fallback: A multi-column box: the same packing, but the tiles fill the first column from the top before the next, so the order seen runs down each column instead of across

classes.name: masonry
classes.description: The lanes: as many equal ones as fit at --masonry-min or wider, packed with grid lanes where the browser has them and as columns elsewhere. It draws nothing

classes.name: masonry-item
classes.description: A tile. It is never split across two lanes, and keeps --masonry-gap from the one above it

properties.name: --masonry-min
properties.description: The narrowest a lane may be; a lane is never wider than the masonry itself

properties.name: --masonry-gap
properties.description: The space between lanes and between the tiles in a lane

example:
• Dunes at noon

    Wind from the west all morning, and the ridges moved a metre.

  • Tide pools

  • The last ferry

    Twelve people, two dogs and a bicycle.
